artifacts.contract: Bounded parent deadline/cancellation propagation with explicit live-parent and completion-acknowledgement obligations; cross-host remaining-budget interpretation declares transport delay assumptions.
Checked lazy token refill with explicit integral/fractional units, burst capacity, monotonic time and admission failure bookkeeping; concurrency and scheduling are separate.
Health state plus separate bounded permit ownership, stale-epoch completion isolation and explicit cooldown/identity exhaustion; no forced cancellation or automatic fairness.

PR-T75-09.question: Which overload and retry policy preserves the telemetry effect/delivery contract under bounded resources?
alternatives: reject before effect with explicit retry ownership
commit into a durable bounded outbox then drain
lossy/coalescing telemetry with an explicit weaker observation contract
PR-T75-09.discriminator: Whether lost or repeated notifications are allowed, what survives reset, and which owner retains outstanding work determine admissibility before latency comparison.
PR-T75-09.reversal_trigger: Effects become irreversible, arrival rate exceeds drain indefinitely or a consumer requires durable notification acknowledgement.
